tagline.en: Ellensburg to Hermiston, thirty years of argument about where
tagline.zh: 从埃伦斯堡到赫米斯顿，为走哪条线争了三十年

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 华盛顿州埃伦斯堡附近，与 I-90 相接

end.zh: 俄勒冈州赫米斯顿附近，与 I-84 相接

en: I-82 is the diagonal that connects central Washington to the Columbia River and the freight routes beyond it. It leaves I-90 at Ellensburg, climbs over two ridges into the Yakima Valley, runs the length of that valley through orchard and vineyard country, skirts the Tri-Cities, crosses the Columbia at Plymouth and ends at I-84 near Hermiston in Oregon.

Almost all of it is in Washington; the Oregon portion is a short connector on the far side of the river. The valley it serves is one of the most productive agricultural districts in the Northwest, and the road exists largely to move that produce toward Portland and the Interstate network.
It is the last of Washington's three Interstates to be built, and the one whose route was argued over longest.
zh: I-82 是把华盛顿州中部与哥伦比亚河及河对岸货运通道连接起来的一条斜线。它自埃伦斯堡离开 I-90，翻越两道山脊进入亚基马谷，纵贯这条布满果园与葡萄园的河谷，绕过三城地区，在普利茅斯跨过哥伦比亚河，终于俄勒冈州赫米斯顿附近的 I-84。
它几乎全在华盛顿州境内；俄勒冈州一侧只是河对岸的一小段连接线。它所服务的河谷是西北部最高产的农业区之一，而这条路存在的主要理由，就是把这些农产品运往波特兰和州际公路网。
它是华盛顿州三条州际公路中最后建成的一条，也是线位争论时间最长的一条。

en: Work began in May 1959 on the northern end, and the road took nearly thirty years to finish. The first segment, Ellensburg to Union Gap, needed thirty-nine separate contracts and took fourteen years, wrapping up in 1975.

Everything south of there was contested. Truckers wanted an alignment that avoided the ridges; the Army insisted the road stay clear of the Yakima Training Center; the Yakama Nation sued over a route across its reservation and won, which moved the freeway to the north bank of the Yakima River. Washington reached Prosser in October 1982.

The bigger fight was over the southern end. Tri-Cities interests wanted the Interstate routed through their area; Oregon officials insisted it cross at Umatilla. In 1973 the two states accepted a federal compromise: I-82 would go to Umatilla and skirt the Tri-Cities, which would be served instead by a spur, I-182. The final 9.9 miles between Umatilla and Hermiston were dedicated and opened on 20 September 1988 — the last piece of the Interstate system built in Oregon.
zh: 工程于 1959 年 5 月自北端动工，全线用了将近三十年才完成。第一段自埃伦斯堡至联合峡（Union Gap），共需三十九份独立合同，历时十四年，于 1975 年收尾。
此处以南的一切都有争议。卡车业者希望线位避开山脊；陆军坚持道路必须远离亚基马训练中心；亚卡马族就穿越其保留地的线路提起诉讼并胜诉，迫使高速公路移到亚基马河北岸。华盛顿州于 1982 年 10 月修到普罗瑟。
更大的争执在南端。三城地区希望州际公路经过本地；俄勒冈州官员则坚持要在尤马蒂拉过河。1973 年，两州接受了一项联邦折中方案：I-82 走尤马蒂拉、绕过三城，改由一条支线 I-182 服务后者。尤马蒂拉与赫米斯顿之间最后的 9.9 英里于 1988 年 9 月 20 日落成通车——这也是俄勒冈州境内州际公路系统建成的最后一块。

en: The signature structure is the Fred G. Redmon Memorial Bridge, which carries I-82 over the Selah Creek gorge north of Yakima. It is a pair of concrete arches, and at the time it was built they were the longest spans of their type in the country. The bridge was dedicated in November 1971 and named for the first chairman of the state highway commission.

The northern approach is the other engineering problem. Between Ellensburg and Selah the freeway crosses Manastash and Umtanum ridges, climbing and descending on long grades that are the reason the trucking industry argued for a valley alignment instead. The route chosen went over the ridges, along the west side of the Yakima Training Center.
zh: 标志性结构是弗雷德·G·雷德蒙纪念大桥，它把 I-82 架过亚基马以北的塞拉溪峡谷。该桥为一对混凝土拱，建成时是全美同类桥型中跨径最大的。大桥于 1971 年 11 月落成，以该州公路委员会首任主席命名。
北段引道是另一道工程难题。在埃伦斯堡与塞拉之间，高速公路要翻越马纳斯塔什与乌姆塔努姆两道山脊，以长纵坡上下——这正是卡车业界当年主张改走河谷线位的原因。最终选定的线路是翻越山脊，沿亚基马训练中心西侧而行。

label.zh: 埃伦斯堡至联合峡路段

value.en: More than $44 million across 39 contracts, in the dollars of the day
value.zh: 按当年美元计，39 份合同合计逾 4,400 万美元

figures.source: Yakima Herald-Republic, 'It Happened Here: Interstate 82 built through Yakima County'

why.en: Neither state transportation department publishes a consolidated construction total for the route. It was built over nearly thirty years as dozens of separate contracts in two states, with the alignment changing several times.
why.zh: 两州交通部门均未发布本路线的合并建设总造价。它历时近三十年，在两个州以数十份独立合同建成，其间线位数次变更。

value.en: 143.78 miles: 132.57 in Washington and 11.21 in Oregon
value.zh: 143.78 英里：华盛顿州 132.57 英里，俄勒冈州 11.21 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Washington and Oregon publish counts by segment. Volumes near Yakima and the Tri-Cities are not comparable with the ridge crossings north of Selah, and no route-wide figure is published.
why.zh: 华盛顿州与俄勒冈州按路段发布交通量。亚基马与三城附近的数值与塞拉以北的翻山路段无从比较，亦未发布全线数字。

label.zh: 弗雷德·G·雷德蒙纪念大桥

value.en: Twin concrete arch spans of 549 feet over Selah Creek, the longest of their design in the United States when completed in 1971
value.zh: 跨越塞拉溪的一对混凝土拱，跨径 549 英尺，1971 年建成时为全美同类设计中跨径最大者

conditionFigures.source: AARoads Interstate 82 Washington guide; Yakima Herald-Republic

timeline.en: Construction begins in May at the northern end, near Ellensburg.
timeline.zh: 5 月，工程自北端埃伦斯堡附近动工。

timeline.en: The Fred G. Redmon Memorial Bridge is dedicated and the Ellensburg–Yakima section opens.
timeline.zh: 弗雷德·G·雷德蒙纪念大桥落成，埃伦斯堡至亚基马路段通车。

timeline.en: Washington and Oregon accept a federal compromise routing I-82 through Umatilla with a spur, I-182, serving the Tri-Cities.
timeline.zh: 华盛顿州与俄勒冈州接受联邦折中方案：I-82 经尤马蒂拉，另设支线 I-182 服务三城地区。

timeline.en: The freeway reaches Prosser after the alignment is moved off the Yakama reservation.
timeline.zh: 线位移出亚卡马保留地后，高速公路修抵普罗瑟。

timeline.en: The last 9.9 miles, between Umatilla and Hermiston, open on 20 September, completing both the route and Oregon's Interstate system.
timeline.zh: 9 月 20 日，尤马蒂拉至赫米斯顿的最后 9.9 英里通车，本路线与俄勒冈州的州际公路系统同时建成。
